messages:
alex: Morning — v1.0 is live. Nice work team. We need a quick triage thread for post-launch follow-ups: bugs vs enhancements, immediate hotfixes, and what we push to the next sprint. Can folks drop the problems they saw and proposed severity?

maya: Saw two user-reported generator hangs during long prompts (~>5k tokens). Repro steps incoming. Marking as potential P0 until we confirm frequency. :bug:

jordan: Also getting some confusion with the new streaming chunking API; docs mismatch on chunk delimiter. That's an enhancement to docs, P2.

sam: From infra: one pod OOM during export job at 03:14 — suspect KV cache growth on long sessions. Logged metrics: `kv_cache_size` spike to 9.2GB. Thinking: short-term rollback of aggressive caching for those routes, long-term memory cap. Propose P1 infra hotfix.

leah: Customer success flagged a regression where webhook retry headers changed — broke one integration. Impact: single customer in enterprise plan. P1 customer-facing bug.

alex: Good list. Let's be pragmatic: P0 = immediate patch and quick rollout (<=24h). P1 = ship within sprint (2 weeks) with canary. P2 = backlog grooming for next milestone.

maya: For generator hangs I can attach logs and a minimal prompt. If it's a KV cache bug we should open a ticket with stack + sample. jira-bot: created RW-1458 for generator-hang (P0).

jordan: Docs fix I'm happy to take — small PR. jira-bot: created RW-1462 for streaming-docs (P2).

sam: OOM incident ticket: RW-1460 (P1). Adding telemetry graphs to the ticket. deploy-bot: triggered canary for infra patch branch `reduce-kv-cache` on prod-dedicated.

leah: Webhook retry header regression ticket: RW-1459 (P1). Also asked support to gather affected customer payloads.

alex: Next steps: 1) P0: block until RW-1458 triaged — maya, pair with eng-runtime. 2) P1: RW-1460 + RW-1459 — sam & leah coordinate on canary and customer communication. 3) P2: RW-1462 — docs PR, small rollout. 4) Grooming: add acceptance criteria to each ticket and estimate.

maya: Acceptance criteria for RW-1458: reproducer script, deterministic hang <-> KV state, unit test added, canary deployment with zero hang for 48h.

jordan: Docs acceptance: update SDK example, add note about chunk delimiter and deprecation warning, link to migration guide.

sam: For RW-1460 put a mitigations section: temporary cache cap `MAX_KV_CACHE=4GB`, autoscaler tweaked to keep headroom, alert if `kv_cache_size` > 3.5GB.

leah: Communication: I'll draft a short customer note for impacted enterprise users explaining root cause investigation and ETA for fix.

alex: Can we get rough estimates in this thread? P0 (RW-1458) — 8h; P1s — 1d infra + 4d testing; docs P2 — 3h. If that matches, I'll request a sprint adjust and reprioritize backlog.

maya: 8h seems right. I'll start now and update RW-1458 with progress.

sam: I'll monitor canary and keep infra rollback ready.

jordan: Docs PR will be in by EOD.

alex: Perfect. Post-launch milestone list for PMs/ENG leads: - Ship RW-1458 (P0 hotfix) - Monitor canary 48h - Ship RW-1460 + RW-1459 in sprint with customer comms - Merge RW-1462 next patch release - Groom remaining items in next triage (Thursday grooming).

leah: Throwing a note: suggest we add a small backlog label and a `customer-impact` tag to make prioritization easier during grooming.

alex: Agreed — add `customer-impact:high|medium|low` and `postlaunch` label. I'll update the backlog filters.

maya: Quick question: do we reopen the feature flag on generator for a/b if hotfix changes quality? We should plan an eval set for regressions.

jordan: Yes — add an eval suite run on canary; if score drop >2% rollback. Ticket RW-1458 updated.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started for branch `reduce-kv-cache` at 2025-11-04T03:42:10Z.

jira-bot: RW-1458 assigned to maya; RW-1459 assigned to leah; RW-1460 assigned to sam; RW-1462 assigned to jordan.

alex: Thanks all. I'll follow up in the Thursday grooming with a compact backlog view. If anyone finds additional P0s, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
